_maxPlausibleDerivedPalletKgNote: Sanity ceiling (kg) for a per-pallet weight CALCULATED from a GROUPAGE cargo summary (total / pallet count — collection-run-parser.ts). Above this the derived figure is KEPT but flagged doubtful for the operator to confirm, never blocked and never discarded. NOT the same knob as config/column-map.json's palletDefaults.plausibleMinKg/plausibleMaxKg (item-assembler.ts): that one guards a per-pallet weight derived from a single manifest's own PROSE total ('Total: 266 pallets | 35,910 kg'), and an out-of-band figure there is DISCARDED entirely in favour of a config default, not kept and flagged. Same shape of guard, different source data, different failure mode -- do not merge them into one value.
